summary: End-to-end freeze sweep across all demo flows (Iter 64 task). Verified 18 routes (9 primary + 9 aliases) + the /demo picker. Zero JS page-errors, zero infinite loaders, zero navigation hangs. Page main-thread stayed responsive (1-4 ms Date.now() round-trip) before start, during auto-advance, and after scene-next clicks across every demo. Supermarket: scenes 1→9 advance cleanly on next-click with ~750 ms click-to-render latency and action ledger ticking 2→14 (agentic core fully live). Startup: Start-Demo-With-Voice starts narration, ledger increments, and scene pager auto-advances scene 1→2 at ~20 s (narration length), no UI block during speech. Education: scene 1→2 auto-advance confirmed within 8 s. Sita/Noldus/Airport/Realtor/Insurance/Creator: all mount scene-1 cleanly, agentic panels present where expected (sita/startup), no error. Picker shows all 8 demo cards and their CTAs resolve. Aliases (/demo/influencer, /demo/enterprise, /demo/airports, /demo/retail, /demo/c-store, /demo/grocery, /demo/school, /demo/schools, /demo/k12) all render the same target component without error. Only known cosmetic React hydration warning from iter 39 (<span> child of <option> in scene-jump <select>) still present — NON-BLOCKING.

critical_code_review_comments: All demo pages gate long-form playback behind an explicit user click (Start Demo / Start Demo With Voice) — correct for browser autoplay policy. Startup/Sita visually signal this with a 'VOICE READY · CLICK START' badge — good UX hint.
Scene-advance latency on Supermarket is ~750 ms per click (mostly transition animation). Acceptable but could be tightened with a shorter CSS transition if demos feel laggy to investors.
SSE/EventSource leak check across navigation: navigated through 9+ demos sequentially in a single page session with no progressive slowdown or memory balloon detected — clean unmount is working.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — no freezes, no infinite loaders, no nav hangs, no blocking JS errors across all 18 routes

rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA. Voice/autoplay gating is not a freeze — it is intentional browser-policy compliance (Chrome/Safari block autoplay audio without user gesture). Scene-1-holds-until-narration-finishes behaviour on Startup demo is by design: the scene pager advances when the current narration completes (~20 s per scene), which is consistent across scene 1→2 observed at t+20s.
